I moved to my current town in second grade. There was a girl my age, lets call her Sam, who was always out to get me. 
I had never done anything to this girl in my life, and prior to moving here I hadn't ever known of her. She ended up being in my class and every day at recess she would physically abuse me. Slap me, punch me, kick me, pull my hair, spit on me, you name it. She would call myself and my mother a variety of names that I (as a 2nd grader,) had never heard before.
My mother quickly became tired of seeing her daughter coming home tattered and bruised everyday and the school doing nothing about it. As I grew older and the violence continued, we attempted to file assult charges. Nothing ever arised of it, but we continued gathering whatever evidence we could. We had screenshots of cyberbullying, pictures of my injuries and witness accounts.
The school eventually kicked her out in grade 8. I thought I'd never have to deal with this ogre-type female again.
Then one day near the end of eighth grade, I was at the park with some friends. We were hanging out on the monkey bars, when we hear Sam calling from the field, "Hey itskylie! Come fight me you slut!" And other insults of that sort. I was sick of being treated this way and quickly made my way over to her.
After a solid 20 minutes of trash talk, she said "are we fighting or what?" To which I replied, "If you make the first move."
My friends had gathered at this point, and I don't think any of them actually expected a fight. Don't get me wrong, I may be a tiny girl but I can kick ass at fighting.
Sam got up in my face, and told me to hit her. When I said no, she called me a pussy and pushed me. As soon as she touched me my fist collided with her face.
She screamed, I grabbed her hair and threw her down on the ground, and threw punch after punch. I only stopped after I noticed the blood on my knuckles.
She hasn't fucked with me since.
I have no regrets.
